Classification diagnostics (Mplus CLASSIFICATION QUALITY)

classification_table.Rd

The classification tables Mplus prints for the most likely class membership.

Usage

classification_table(object, wave = 1)

Arguments

object

A fitted LCA, LPA or growth model (latentmix).

wave

For an LTA, the wave whose classification quality is reported (marginal posteriors of that wave).

Value

A list of three K by K matrices:

avgpost

[j, k]: average posterior probability of class k among cases whose most likely class is j ("Average Latent Class Probabilities for Most Likely Latent Class Membership");

errors

[k, j]: probability that the most likely class is j given true class k ("Classification Probabilities for the Most Likely Latent Class Membership"); the misclassification matrix used by r3step() and bch();

logits

log(errors[k, j] / errors[k, K]).

See also

classify(), fitstats() (entropy)

Examples

data(aces)
# \donttest{
# how well are respondents assigned to the ACE classes?
m <- lca(aces, starts_with("ace_"), K = 4)     # 4 ACE classes, as generated
#> Starting Julia ...
ct <- classification_table(m)
round(diag(ct$avgpost), 2)   # average posterior of the modal class; >= 0.8 is good
#> [1] 0.92 0.85 0.79 0.81
# }
